description: Form USt 1 H of a company for one year: the Antrag auf Dauerfristverlängerung and the Anmeldung der Sondervorauszahlung, computed from the VAT Returns filed for the previous year and transmitted through ELSTER.

fields.description: The calendar year the form is filed for.
fields.label: Year

fields.description: Tick in the year the company applies. Without it, the Dauerfristverlängerung granted before holds on: a monthly filer registers the Sondervorauszahlung of the year, a quarterly filer files nothing.
fields.label: Application for the Dauerfristverlängerung

fields.description: The month whose Voranmeldung the Dauerfristverlängerung covers first, 1 to 12; filing quarterly, the first month of the quarter.
fields.label: First Month Covered

fields.description: The form corrects an Anmeldung der Sondervorauszahlung filed before, as every amendment of a filed form does.
fields.label: Corrected Return (Kz 10)

fields.description: Monthly filers register the Sondervorauszahlung, quarterly filers apply for the Dauerfristverlängerung alone, as the VAT Return Settings prescribe for the first month covered.
fields.label: Kind of Form

fields.description: With the Antrag, the day the first Voranmeldung it covers is due without the extension, and the Sondervorauszahlung with it; otherwise 10 February. A Saturday, a Sunday or a holiday of the company's Holiday List moves it to the next working day.
fields.label: Due Date

fields.description: The last Voranmeldung of the year, which deducts the Sondervorauszahlung.
fields.label: Credited in Kz 39 of

fields.description: Set while Prüfen, Testsenden or Senden runs; the form cannot change until it ends.
fields.label: Transmission Running

fields.description: The latest filing of each Voranmeldungszeitraum, filled by Calculate.
fields.label: Filed Voranmeldungen of the Previous Year

fields.description: Voranmeldungszeiträume of the previous year without a filed VAT Return or without a filing period in the VAT Return Settings.
fields.label: Missing from the Base

fields.description: From the company, read by Calculate. A start in the previous year converts its Vorauszahlungen into an annual sum; a start this year bases the Sondervorauszahlung on the Vorauszahlungen expected.
fields.label: Date of Establishment

fields.description: 12 for a whole year; after a start in the previous year its months of that year, after a start this year its months of this year. A month begun counts in full.
fields.label: Months of Activity

fields.description: The sum of Kz 83 and Kz 39, converted into an annual sum after a start in the previous year.
fields.label: Base from the Voranmeldungen

fields.description: For what the ledger cannot know, with the reason; for a company that began this year, the Vorauszahlungen it expects for the year. It counts once the reason is entered.
fields.label: Base by Hand
Reason for the Base by Hand

fields.description: The base Kz 38 follows from: the one from the Voranmeldungen or the one by hand.
fields.label: Base (Line 8)

fields.description: One eleventh of the base in whole euros, 0 for a surplus; for a company that began this year, the base divided by its months of activity.
fields.label: Sondervorauszahlung (Kz 38)

fields.description: Only with a corrected Anmeldung (Kz 10).
fields.label: Offset Requested or Refund Assigned (Kz 29)
Do Not Use the SEPA Direct Debit Mandate (Kz 26)

fields.description: Required with Kz 500: at most 180 characters on one line.
fields.label: Explanation for Kz 500

fields.description: What keeps the form from being ready, found by Calculate. A form that is not ready is filed with remarks only.
fields.label: Open Points

fields.description: Required to file a form that is not ready: why it is correct nonetheless.
fields.label: Remarks

name: VAT Return Extension
